title: The Trade Marks Ordinance, 2001
note: amended by the Trade Marks (Amendment) Act, 2023 (Madrid Protocol registration); no repeal found -- DRS's 'Repealed' is wrong

title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
note: in force as Pakistani law; no repeal found -- DRS's 'Repealed' is wrong

title: The Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950
note: amended by the Imports and Exports (Control) (Amendment) Act, 2025 -- DRS's 'Repealed' is wrong

title: The Special Marriage Act, 1872
note: in force in Pakistan; the repeal the web shows is India's (Special Marriage Act, 1954)

title: The Arms Act, 1878
note: repealed by the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 except its provisions on manufacture (including conversion), export and import of arms, ammunition and military stores

title: The Land Reforms Act, 1977
note: its provisions on ceilings on agricultural land and resumption of surplus land were held repugnant to Islam: Qazalbash Waqf v. Chief Land Commissioner, PLD 1990 SC 99 (review dismissed, 1993 SCMR 1697)

title: The Government Savings Banks Act, 1873
note: National Savings still operates under it; no repeal found in Pakistan

title: The Carriers Act, 1865
note: the Pakistan Code lists it; no repeal in Pakistan found (the web shows India's repeal by the Carriage by Road Act, 2007)

title: The Married Women's Property Act, 1874
note: the Pakistan Code lists it; no repeal in Pakistan found on the web

title: The Measures of Length Act, 1889
note: the Pakistan Code lists it; no repeal in Pakistan found (the web shows India's repeal of 1956)

title: The Standards of Weight Act, 1939
note: the Pakistan Code lists it; no repeal in Pakistan found (the web shows India's repeal of 1956)

title: The Cattle-trespass Act, 1871
note: Pakistan's version extends to the whole of Pakistan; no repeal found

title: Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, 1962
note: still administered: the Punjab Health Department lists it among its laws; CPSP is a statutory body under it -- DRS's 'Lapsed' is wrong

title: The Law Reforms Ordinance, 1972
note: still operative: a National Assembly committee considered a bill amending its section 3

title: The Law Reports Act, 1875
note: the Pakistan Code lists it; nothing on the web either way for Pakistan

title: The Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from Service) Ordinance
note: the Pakistan Code lists it; an Ordinance of the 1999-2002 period, which the Constitution (Article 270AA) continued; nothing on the web either way

title: The Legal Framework Order, 2002
note: declared made without lawful authority and of no legal effect by Article 270AA of the Constitution, as substituted by the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010 (with the Legal Framework (Amendment) Order and (Second Amendment) Order, 2002) -- DRS's 'Existing' is wrong

title: The Islamabad High Court (Establishment) Order, 2007
note: President's Order No. 7 of 2007, struck down by the Supreme Court on 31 July 2009 (the judiciary restored to its position of 2 November 2007); the court was re-established in 2010 under the Eighteenth Amendment and the Islamabad High Court Act, 2010 -- DRS's 'Existing' is wrong
